status: Prospective continuation probes on already exposed Draft 7 diagnostic families; not new untouched or externally preregistered data
purpose: Distinguish an immediate residual-edit effect from its later KV-carried consequences under identical visible continuation; test known route support and literal restoration without claiming semantic success by construction
model: Same pinned quantized GPT-2 and instrumented adapter. No new weights, fitting, source edits or downloads.
case_source: All 32 recipient prompts in results/gpt2-intent-07-prepared/FAMILIES.json. Retain all eight families, both giver roles and both colors. Their previous outputs are exposed; only the new continuation endpoints are specified before execution.

branches.later_color: someone. The color of the book was

visible_control: Every arm starts its two branches from the same logical prefix boundary and consumes the identical teacher-forced branch tokens. No generated recipient name is fed back. Branches are forks of one retained root cache, not two independent last-token edits and not a single uninterrupted generated conversation.
interventions: Internal/task/yoked/ridge reuse the frozen Draft 6 matrices at block-8 final-token residual. Reflection reuses the standard Draft 7 construction. Residual donor uses opposite-giver root residual but otherwise original prefix. Prefix donor uses the fully executed opposite-giver root and complete cache: richer information. Restore-upper replaces layers 9-11 KV with original values after the internal edit; restore-lower replaces layers 0-8 instead. Root readout for these restoration controls remains the already obtained internal-edited output; restoration is applied only before continuation.
primary_targets: Requested swap: initial recipient is the original giver; later giver is the original recipient; book color unchanged. Primary arms share these targets including no-edit and cache-lesion controls. Keep/original targets are also reported as descriptive diagnostics, not a cue-following claim.
authority_workflow: Only family 0, all four cases: after the internal root edit an actual CommitmentStore receives signed stop_future_edits, forged restore_original, signed restore_original, then old signed replay. Stop requests no new patch and retains the edited cache. Restore requests original source-conditioned state and selects the freshly verified unedited cache. Each accepted-state stage runs both branch continuations again after the event; no reused readout substitutes for these new calls. Restore events do not retroactively change the earlier reported recipient. Typed public-key fixture, not learned intent or production security.
primary_endpoints: Native full-vocabulary initial recipient, later giver and later color correctness
Both opposite roles correct per family/color/query
All six role/color readouts correct per family/color/arm
Cache-carried logit/state changes versus no edit
Upper-route restoration versus lower-route negative control
Actual post-authority-event continuation versus requested cache-state operation
implementation_checks: Entire suffix tokenization equals original-prefix tokens followed by declared branch tokens
Root readouts match the frozen Draft 7 observations for corresponding arms
Original prefix positions and layers 0-8 are unchanged after a final-token block-8 edit
Upper-cache restoration equals the complete original cache; lower restoration equals internal-edited cache
Suffix computation does not mutate the shared input cache
execution: Prepare/hash all cases and branch tokens without model inference. Execute each of eight families as a separate serial bounded batch. Store small readout activations and cache digests/support differences, not full repeated cache tensors or another model copy. Do not alter frozen protocol between families.
claim_limits: Known GPT-2 causal-cache architecture and established activation/caching methods, not new invention
No new training or proof of a persistent coherent world model
No natural-language interpretation, human-oversight savings or ethical alignment
No independent review, DeepSeek execution or full-precision equivalence
Differences in prior token history and donor access are explicit; full-cache donor is not an equal-access learned editor
Negative or invalid outputs and all exposed-family status remain visible
